goal: Produce source-grounded, audience-appropriate, human-approved writing without silently changing facts, meaning, language constraints, or approved decisions.

stages.name: writing_strategy
stages.goal: Define why the writing exists, for whom, in what format, with what constraints and desired reader action.
stages.memory_effect: Creates approved writing requirements and explicit unknowns; does not create external facts.

stages.name: textual_research
stages.goal: Find and record relevant textual sources with provenance, scope, date, reliability, and intended use.
stages.memory_effect: Adds source evidence only; source discovery does not equal endorsement or project decision.

stages.name: source_analysis
stages.goal: Understand source structure, key terms, claims, evidence, complexity, uncertainty, and limitations without prematurely drafting public copy.
stages.memory_effect: Creates DERIVED analysis traceable to source evidence; unsupported interpretation remains UNKNOWN.

stages.name: content_synthesis
stages.goal: Select and combine relevant source-backed ideas into a coherent content thesis while preserving claim provenance and uncertainty.
stages.memory_effect: Creates derived content logic, not final wording or new source facts.

stages.name: content_structure
stages.goal: Convert approved synthesis into a platform-appropriate outline, reading order, hierarchy, and content-unit plan.
stages.memory_effect: Creates structural decisions while preserving meaning and source traceability.

stages.name: drafting
stages.goal: Write the content within the approved brief and structure without introducing unsupported claims or changing locked requirements.
stages.memory_effect: Creates OUTPUT text only; drafts are not approved project knowledge.

stages.name: language_adaptation
stages.goal: Adapt vocabulary, sentence complexity, tone, register, and audience accessibility while preserving factual and semantic meaning.
stages.memory_effect: Creates a transformed OUTPUT version linked to its source draft; simplification may not alter claim meaning.

stages.name: writing_quality_control
stages.goal: Evaluate factual accuracy, source quality, claim support, clarity, purpose, audience fit, language level, meaning preservation, tone, grammar, and handoff readiness.
stages.memory_effect: Records quality evidence and root-cause revision routes; scores cannot override critical failures.

stages.name: human_content_approval
stages.goal: Allow the authorized human to approve, revise, or reject the writing after QC.
stages.memory_effect: Creates an approved content decision; approval is limited to Writing and does not imply Design approval.

stages.name: design_handoff
stages.goal: Transfer approved writing to Design with explicit version, lock/flexibility states, semantic hierarchy, source status, and unresolved unknowns.
stages.memory_effect: Creates a handoff record only; Design receives approved content authority but cannot silently re-author it.
